dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Advertisement Board
dialogues.text: Due to the temporary cessation of Jade Steel supplies, orders for exquisite Jade Steel swords and knives will not be accepted.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Advertisement Board
dialogues.text: If you are looking to forge everyday ironware or ordinary weapons, please visit my disciple Hajime instead. Do not disturb me!
